title: Warm Silky Slovakian Pork Stir Fry
description: A hearty and flavorful Slovakian dish featuring tender pork, crunchy vegetables, and soft bread rolls, all stir-fried in a silky mustard sauce. This paleo-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pork strips and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Dijon mustard and chicken broth.
Pour the mustard sauce into the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the pork to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Split the bread rolls in half and toast until lightly browned.
Serve the pork and vegetable mixture over the toasted bread rolls.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F, then rest 3 minutes before serving.
